title: Git
intro: Git interview questions cover the version control system every developer touches daily — the difference between merge and rebase (and when to use each), interactive rebase for cleaning history, git bisect for finding the commit that broke a test, cherry-pick vs merge for backporting, resolving merge conflicts, Git hooks for code quality, monorepo vs polyrepo trade-offs, GitFlow vs trunk-based development, and the production scenarios interviewers love ("someone committed a secret to git — what now?"). For Maven/Gradle build-tool questions, see the Java Build Tools page.
